create.name: Lama Tsultrim Allione
create.bio:
Lama Tsultrim Allione is an American teacher of Tibetan Buddhism and the founder of Tara Mandala, a large retreat centre in the mountains near Pagosa Springs in south-west Colorado whose temple is devoted to the sacred feminine in Buddhism. Raised in New England, she went to Asia as a teenager and in 1970, aged twenty-two, took ordination as a Tibetan Buddhist nun in Bodhgaya, the first American woman to do so. She later returned her vows, married and raised three children. In 2007 teachers in Tibet and Nepal recognised her as an emanation of Machig Labdrön, the eleventh-century yogini who founded the Chöd lineage, and she is one of very few women lamas teaching today.

She is best known for Feeding Your Demons, a five-step method adapted from Chöd in which people meet difficult emotions and patterns with curiosity and compassion rather than fighting them; it is now taught by a circle of authorised teachers. Her books include Women of Wisdom, Feeding Your Demons and Wisdom Rising. From Tara Mandala she leads retreats, long-term study pathways such as Magyu: The Mother Lineage, live courses on Zoom and self-paced online programmes on Green Tara, the Heart Sutra, Machig's teachings on the nature of mind and the five wisdom dakinis, and she guides a network of more than forty practice groups around the world.

videos.title: How to Practice Shamatha Meditation: Calm Abiding with Lama Tsultrim Allione

books.title: Feeding Your Demons: Ancient Wisdom for Resolving Inner Conflict
books.author: Tsultrim Allione
books.description: Her best-known book, which sets out the five steps of Feeding Your Demons. Drawing on the Tibetan practice of Chöd, it shows how to give form to a difficult emotion or pattern and meet it with care instead of resistance.

courses.title: The Great Perfection
courses.description: A live course on Zoom, taught with Tulku Ösel Dorje and Sangye Khandro, on recognising natural awareness in the Dzogchen tradition, including women's perspectives in its lineages. Sessions run on Friday mornings and it closes a year-long study series on the heart of Buddhism.

courses.title: Green Tara Self Paced Program
courses.description: A recorded course with Dorje Lopön Charlotte Rotterdam on the Green Tara sadhana, a Tibetan practice that joins chanting, prayer, visualisation and meditation. It has about nine hours of video and works as an introduction to deity practice.

courses.title: Machig Labdron and the Nature of Mind Self Paced Program
courses.description: Recorded teachings on Machig's Last Instructions, the final pith teachings the eleventh-century yogini gave her students. The focus is meditation on the nature of mind rather than on Chöd ritual.

courses.title: Journey into the Mandala of the Empowered Feminine Self Paced Program
courses.description: A recorded course on the mandala principle and the practice of the five wisdom dakinis, combining sound, visualisation and meditation. Each dakini is linked to an emotional pattern and the wisdom it can turn into.

courses.title: Opening the Heart Sutra Self Paced Program
courses.description: About three hours of recorded teaching that takes students through the Heart Sutra line by line, as a way into Mahayana thought and the Middle Way. Audio downloads and a practice text are included.

courses.title: Feeding Your Demons Online Program
courses.description: An online training in her Feeding Your Demons method, taught alongside her senior students Charlotte Rotterdam and Pieter Oosthuizen. It can be taken in parts for personal practice or in full towards certification.
